display.overview_panels: 1 km cell values (cell centres) interpolated bilinearly in geographic coordinates, NaN-aware, onto the hillshade display grid before draping; drawn/no-data/area-of-applicability masks follow the containing 1 km cell
display.exact_cell_panels: zoom windows (paper d, g; deck R07 b, c; R08 a, b; R09 b) and the area-of-applicability map (paper e; deck R08 c)
display.masks: only the continuous ALT and ALT-difference values are interpolated; the drawn / non-permafrost land / no-data masks stay at native 1 km cell resolution. In the sporadic-permafrost belt of west-central Alaska (about 60-63 N) this leaves 1 km block edges next to smooth gradients: they are data boundaries (CCI permafrost fraction < 10 %, missing ERA5-Land soil forcing or CCI value), not a rendering defect

gap_fill.rule: overview panels only: gaps (water or no data) between drawn cells whose 4-connected component is <= 2 cell are filled with the interpolated value for display; the analysis masks and the zoom windows are unchanged
gap_fill.remaining: fine white specks left in the Lena Delta overview are water / no-data gaps of > 2 cells (channels and lakes of > 2 km2) at native 1 km resolution

display.observed_cell_circles: open circles with a white casing drawn per circle (later circles overprint earlier ones), so overlapping circles stay separable; circles still overlap in dense clusters of the overview panels and where station spacing approaches the 1 km cell pitch (paper g, deck R09 b)
display.caption_note_ko: 표시: 개관 지도는 1 km 셀 값을 250 m 음영 격자에 쌍선형 보간(마스크는 1 km 그대로, 1셀 틈은 메움), 확대 창은 1 km 셀 그대로. 원 = 관측 셀(촘촘한 곳은 겹침). 서남부 산발 영구동토대의 각진 경계는 자료 경계(영구동토 확률 < 10 %, 강제력 결측)이다.
display.caption_note_en: Overview maps drape 1 km cell values interpolated to the 250 m hillshade grid (masks at native 1 km; single-cell gaps filled for display); zoom windows show exact 1 km cells. Circles mark observed cells and may overlap in dense clusters; block edges in the sporadic-permafrost belt are data boundaries.
